scope: CCXT native OCO reconciliation query failure persists an unknown-state barrier

assertions: an active OKX OCO is moved to ReconcileRequired on an unknown query outcome
both still-active child orders append ReconcileRequired EventLog facts and become Unknown
the persisted group snapshot and reconciliation issue retain the OKX-specific reason
the service reconciler issues fetch_order_group with the persisted OKX algo_id and instrument
the local CCXT RPC mock returns a query timeout and the persisted group becomes ReconcileRequired
both child orders remain Unknown and a venue-specific issue is emitted

limitations: The RPC error is injected by a local mock; no OKX or Bitget API/Demo request was made.
